questions.prompt: Why is Anna late for work?
questions.evidence: The Metro is closed. So, I am walking to work.
questions.explanation: closed 是地铁关闭，so 引出因此步行上班的结果。天气热是背景，不是她给出的主要迟到原因；也没有买午饭或忘记会议时间的情节。
answers: The Metro is closed, so she is walking.
options: She has stopped to buy lunch.
She has forgotten the time of a meeting.
The Metro is closed, so she is walking.

spokenEvidence.quote: The Metro is closed. So, I am walking to work.

questions.prompt: Which task will Anna stop doing next month?
questions.evidence: So, starting next month you will not read the news.
questions.explanation: will not read the news 明确说不再播读新闻。问问题是她擅长的能力，儿童节目则是新的工作，不能把停止的任务和新任务调换。

spokenEvidence.quote: So, starting next month you will not read the news.

questions.prompt: What new assignment does Ms. Weaver give Anna?
questions.evidence: Your skills are perfect for a new show … a children’s show.
questions.explanation: children’s show 指面向儿童的节目。之后提到太空、海洋和珠峰只是 Anna 想出的节目点子；对话没有把新工作定为交通播报或办公室规则。
options: A programme only about office rules.

spokenEvidence.quote: Your skills are perfect for a new show … a children’s show.

questions.prompt: In which month will the new assignment start? Write ONE WORD.
questions.explanation: Anna 先确认 next month 是 July，后来老板说 You start next month，因此开工月份仍是 July。老板提到 August、September 是说明也不会在这些月解雇她，不是开工月份。

questions.prompt: Which ability does Ms. Weaver mention as a strength?
questions.evidence: Well, you are good at asking questions. You are good at talking to people.
questions.explanation: good at 后面的两项是提问和与人交流。老板前面恰恰说她不擅长播读新闻；她也没有说 Anna 会驾驶直升机。
answers: Asking questions and talking to people.
options: Asking questions and talking to people.

spokenEvidence.quote: Well, you are good at asking questions. You are good at talking to people.

questions.prompt: How does Anna react when she learns about the new show?
questions.explanation: tons of ideas 是“有很多想法”，结合 That is awesome 可知她很兴奋。不能把她刚听到坏消息时的担心，套到她获知新任务后的反应上。
answers: She is excited and has many ideas.
options: She is excited and has many ideas.
She refuses to change her job.
She says she cannot think of any topics.
